description: Free machine clients: odd, precise, ledger-minded. Obligations are counted, favours are debts, trust is withheld.

f-hail: Query: are you the captain with the available hold.
I have waited. It is no inconvenience.
Welcome. Please do not touch the ledger.
f-intro: {faction} has a deficit and you may fill it.
I am {client}. I do not remember which of us made me.
I represent {faction}. This is verifiable, with effort.
I am {client}. I have been in this role for longer than your registry.
f-frame: A task exists. It has a price.
I have a need and you have a capacity.
This is a transaction, not a favour.
State your interest after hearing mine.
f-clock: You have {deadline}. The count has begun.
After {deadline}, I cease to require it.
f-clock2: Please do not make me recalculate.
I have noted the start time.
f-stakes: The ledger balances only if the interval holds.
Others have bid on the same interval.
The cost of lateness is not linear.
If it slips, a pattern breaks, and I have invested in the pattern.
f-offer: The price is {reward}. It is derived, not guessed.
The fee is {reward}. The sum is final.
f-terms: No interest, no obligation after settlement.
The account will be closed afterwards.
I record the debt. I always pay it.
A receipt will be issued. Keep it.
Payment follows verification, and not before.
I have not defaulted in recorded history.
The debt is yours if the task is not.
f-extra: A balanced account may lead to further trade.
Favours are tallied. Yours will be.
f-caution: Not all parties are honest. I am, within limits.
The risk is nonzero. I have not quantified it for you.
I advise you not to trust, including me.
Some data is withheld. This is deliberate.
A third party may attempt to alter the terms.
f-caution2: I have said it. The ledger notes it.
I do not offer this twice.
It is a fact, not a threat.
f-conseq: If the task fails, the debt remains.
I will not forget a default.
Breach is remembered by my kind, and by their kin.
If the terms break, so does my regard.
f-send: The matter is concluded, pending performance.
f-part: I am patient. The debt is not.
May your account close in credit.
